newsitem.title: UK: Zinc physicals solid, nickel outlook improving.
newsitem.headline: Zinc physicals solid, nickel outlook improving.

text.p: Physical zinc business continues to be good in most areas, maintaining European premiums and underpinning a strong LME price, traders said.

Elsewhere in the European base metal physical sector spot nickel business is patchy, but the outlook for the second half of the year looks better, while copper trading continues to be restrained by perceived high prices.
"As regards copper, we would like to see lower prices. For Continental consumers it is still expensive," one European trader said.
Others said copper trading was taking place, where specific comitments had to be done, lead continued slow, but zinc business was good.
Wednesday's U.S. Mint zinc tender, where average premiums were in the 5.6 cents/lb range, confirmed the strength of the American physical sector.
"There has been good business in the U.S., the Far East, and in Europe," one said.
